verdict.rationale: Azure documents its own primitives for scoped, credential-free workload access: Azure RBAC gives fine-grained, per-resource authorization, and managed identities let applications obtain Entra tokens without handling secrets. Neither is documented as an agent-specific pattern, and the pack does not show tokens being time-bounded or protected against escalation. missing for 10: agent-specific delegation patterns, explicit temporary/expiring credential documentation, anti-escalation guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native team, agents get their own leash — documented patterns for handing an agent temporary, narrowly-scoped credentials it cannot escalate

citations.quote: Azure RBAC is an authorization system built on Azure Resource Manager that provides fine-grained access management to Azure resources.
Applications can use managed identities to obtain Microsoft Entra tokens without having to manage any credentials.
Allow one user to manage virtual machines in a subscription and another user to manage virtual networks
